1.0.0: MCPGateway: expose action components and MCP servers connected to the 'tool' port as MCP tools; fields marked with 'Model Defined Parameter' become tool parameters.
1.1.0: Remote MCP endpoint: Streamable HTTP transport at /plugins/appmixer/ai/mcptools/mcp (POST for JSON-RPC, GET for the tools/list_changed notification stream), serving the authenticated user's MCP Gateway tools without the stdio appmixer-mcp process.

OAuth 2.1 resource server: bearer token validation with RFC 8707 audience binding, RFC 9728 protected resource metadata at /plugins/appmixer/ai/mcptools/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource, and a WWW-Authenticate challenge on 401.
